best_lineage.idea: Replace the naive i-j-k scalar triple loop with a multithreaded i-k-j tiled kernel: each thread owns contiguous rows of C, the inner j-loop accumulates a small block of C columns in NEON vectors while the k-loop streams contiguous rows of A and B, which should let the compiler auto-vectorize and hide memory latency across ~10 threads.
